facts.fact: 女王低唤 my love 唤醒 Henry
facts.anchor: “It’s time to wake up, my love,” she murmured.

facts.fact: Henry 开场：你是我见过第一位 Catalogue 选的馆长
facts.anchor: “You are the first Head Librarian I’ve ever met,” he said.
So, you didn’t like my work?

facts.fact: 上任才知：数世纪的审查运动
facts.anchor: For centuries, The Central Library had been engaged in a campaign of censorship.

facts.fact: 为偷一晚平静推迟艰难对话
facts.anchor: He asked me to go with him that night and, selfishly, I agreed to put off the difficult conversation

facts.fact: 埋葬真相且仅限议事会内部
facts.anchor: So, not only did we bury the truth, but the decision was made to keep the knowledge within the Council alone.

facts.fact: 她的推论：连 Atalanthya 也不知道、只是傀儡
facts.anchor: If what Henry said was true, then even Atalanthya did not know the Library’s secret history.

facts.fact: 殿堂毁人：容他滑回监狱之页
facts.anchor: The Hall of Guardians breaks people. I couldn’t bring myself to end it
Standing tall, she finally saw the man he once was
